sections.title: Onboarding
sections.goal: build commitment and personalise the plan before the paywall. Target 60%+ of installs completing it.

tasks.title: Welcome and promise: "Don't quit today. Quit on your Quit Day."
Age confirmation (18+). Under 18: friendly exit with a pointer to free youth resources.
Product selection, multi-select: cigarettes, vape, pouches, NRT already in use. Dual use supported.
Usage baseline per product: amount per day (cigarettes, puffs or sessions, pouches with strength in mg), cost per unit or per pack and currency, years of use.
Triggers and when cravings usually hit (multi-select).
Reasons to quit, in the user's own words, with an optional photo. Reused in pledge and SOS.
Past quit attempts and what happened (short, optional).
Choose Quit Day: the date the prep phase ends, with a recommended default.
NRT interest: using it, want it, not interested.
Plan reveal: personal summary of their program, Quit Day, money they'll keep, what the next 7 days look like. This comes **before** the paywall.
Notification permission, asked after the plan reveal with a clear reason.
Optional App Store review prompt placement (ask Milan).
tasks.notes: Question for Milan: show the App Store review prompt in onboarding? If so, where?

tasks.title: Funnel analytics on every screen; one-tap skip where a question is optional.

sections.title: Paywall
sections.goal: honest, high-converting. Billing traps were the top one-star theme across competitors.

tasks.title: Paywall screen after plan reveal, addressed by name, showing what's included.
Plans: monthly, annual (highlighted), lifetime. Prices from RevenueCat; placeholder starting point $9.99/mo, $39.99/yr, $79.99 lifetime — confirm with Milan.
tasks.notes: Question for Milan: confirm $9.99/mo, $39.99/yr, $79.99 lifetime.

tasks.title: Free trial on annual (3 days unless Milan says otherwise), with the exact charge date stated on screen.
tasks.notes: Question for Milan: 3-day trial on annual — confirm.

tasks.title: Plain-language terms: how to cancel in two taps, link to Apple subscription management, refund note.
Free tier that's genuinely useful: counter, craving SOS, Day 1 of the program. Clear upgrade points elsewhere.
Restore purchases; entitlement checks; paywall dismiss path.
No ads anywhere in the app.
Regional pricing hook for India (configured in App Store Connect later).
Hero progress visual (direction set by DESIGN_METHODOLOGY.md) showing days clear and progress; slips do not reset it.
Per-product counters: cigarettes, puffs or pouches not used; money kept; time regained.
tasks.notes: Question for Milan: what should 'time regained' mean? Any minutes-per-cigarette figure is a health claim and needs a source.

tasks.title: Prep-phase state: countdown to Quit Day, "you can still use during prep", today's prep lesson.
Today's program card: day N of 7, lesson title, duration, start or continue.
Craving button always reachable from Home (thumb zone).
Upcoming milestone hint.
Glass navigation (tab bar: Today, Program, Progress) with iOS 26 Liquid Glass and fallback.
Port program content from the Flutter build: prep phase, 7-day program, 4-week maintenance arc.
tasks.notes: Question for Milan: where is the previous Flutter build (repo URL or path)? Needed to port content.

tasks.title: Product variants: smoking, vaping, pouches; dual users get the variant for their main product plus notes for the others (confirm rule with Milan).
tasks.notes: Question for Milan: dual users — main-product variant plus notes for the others. Confirm the rule.

tasks.title: Day locking: a day unlocks only after the previous day is completed.
Lesson player: text, audio or short exercises as content requires; completion tracking.
Prep phase until Quit Day, then the quit days.
Maintenance arc (weeks 2–5) changes format, not just content, to avoid the week 3–4 drop-off.
Inactivity behaviour per Milan's answer to the open decision in part 1.
tasks.notes: Open decision from plan §1: keep the 3-idle-day reset to Day 1, or pause and replay the last day?

tasks.title: Program overview screen: past, current and locked days.

sections.title: Craving SOS
sections.goal: opens in under a second, from anywhere.

tasks.title: SOS screen: urge-surfing timer (about 3 minutes), guided breathing, the user's reasons and photo.
Core Haptics pattern that slows as the session progresses; Reduce Motion and haptics-off fallbacks.
Outcomes: "It passed" (logs a craving resisted), "I slipped" (goes to slip debrief), "Ping a friend" (share sheet in v1; buddy system comes later).
Live Activity and Dynamic Island showing the countdown with an "It passed" action.
Entry points: Home button, home screen widget, lock screen widget, Control Center control, App Intent / Siri ("I'm having a craving").
Log every SOS session with time and trigger for insights.
One-tap logging per product (cigarette, puff session, pouch) from the app, an interactive widget and an App Intent.
Trigger and craving log with optional mood and context.
Insights screen: time-of-day heat map of cravings and uses, top triggers, trend over time. Shows "needs a week of data" until there's enough.
Progress screen: money kept, units avoided, time regained, cravings ridden out.
Slip logging from SOS, Home and the widget.
Sixty-second slip debrief: what happened, what triggered it, one thing to try next time.
Supportive messages (copy from Milan; placeholders until then). Streak and progress visual unchanged.
tasks.notes: Needs supportive slip copy from Milan (placeholders until then).

tasks.title: Slips feed the insights screen.
NRT setup: patch, gum, lozenge, inhaler; strength.
Step-down schedules that follow standard product-label guidance only; every screen says to follow the label and ask a pharmacist or doctor. No dosing advice beyond the label.
Pouch-strength taper plan for pouch users (e.g. stepping down mg over weeks), with reminders.
Reminders for patch changes and step-down dates.
NRT shown on Home and Progress.
Per-product timeline (smoking, vaping, pouches) of what changes in the body over time.
Every item carries a source citation the user can open. Best public sources for now; keep wording conservative.
Store timeline content as data (JSON) so it can be corrected without code changes.
Morning pledge with the user's own reason and photo.
Evening check-in: how today went, cravings, mood.
User-set day boundary (when "today" ends) so late-night check-ins count for the right day.
Gentle reminders for both, user-controllable.
Three to five short exercises: breathing patterns, grounding, a brief ACT-style "notice and name" exercise.
Reachable from SOS and the Program tab.
A plain line pointing to professional help and local helplines; no diagnosis or clinical claims.
Milestone schedule (confirm with Milan; suggested: Quit Day, day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 100, 180, 365).
tasks.notes: Question for Milan: confirm milestone schedule (Quit Day, day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 100, 180, 365).

tasks.title: Milestone celebration moment in-app, with haptics and motion; respects Reduce Motion.
Share cards rendered with `ImageRenderer` for Instagram Stories (9:16) and WhatsApp; opt-in, user picks what to show (days, money, cravings ridden out).
Wordmark on every card; no personal data shown by default.
Notification plan: pledge, check-in, lesson available, milestone, NRT reminders, inactivity nudges per the open decision.
Quiet hours and per-type toggles in Settings.
No guilt copy in any notification.
Settings: products and baselines, Quit Day, day boundary, notifications, haptics, appearance.
Subscription management link, restore purchases.
Data export and delete-all-data.
Privacy: local-first; analytics disclosure; privacy policy and terms links (ask Milan for URLs).
tasks.notes: Needs privacy policy and terms URLs from Milan.

tasks.title: Accessibility pass across the whole app: VoiceOver labels on every control and the hero visual, full Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency, contrast.
Health disclaimer: educational support, not medical treatment.
End-to-end test of the full journey: onboarding → paywall → prep → Quit Day → day 7 → maintenance.
Test on small and large iPhones, iOS 18 and iOS 26, light and dark, largest text size.
App Store assets: screenshots, preview video, description (ask Milan for copy).
tasks.notes: Needs App Store copy from Milan.

Launch checklist in the tracker.
